prompt: Fix normalize_sku in inventory/catalog.py: trim surrounding whitespace and normalize nonempty SKU strings with Unicode upper(), including mixed case. Keep its signature, TypeError for nonstrings, ValueError for empty/whitespace-only strings, and existing uppercase identifiers unchanged. Keep other behavior intact and validate the change.

Fix parse_price_cents in inventory/catalog.py so major-unit prices convert to exact integer cents without binary-float truncation (for example 1.15 -> 115 and 0.29 -> 29). Accept int, float, Decimal and numeric strings; permit extra trailing decimal zeros but reject fractional cents, negative/nonfinite values and malformed strings with ValueError. Reject bool and unsupported input types with TypeError. Preserve the public API and other product behavior; validate edge cases.

Fix reserve_stock in inventory/catalog.py: count must be a positive integer, with TypeError for bool/nonintegers and ValueError for zero, negative values, or insufficient stock. Return a new frozen Product, preserve all non-stock fields, and do not mutate the original. Keep valid full and partial reservations compatible and validate them.

Fix tag handling in load_product in inventory/catalog.py. Tags are an optional list or tuple of strings; trim and Unicode-casefold them, drop blank tags, deduplicate while preserving first occurrence order, and store a tuple. Reject other containers or nonstring members with TypeError. Do not mutate the payload or its tags. Preserve SKU, name, price and stock behavior and the public signature; validate the change.

Improve search_products in inventory/search.py: split a string query on whitespace, Unicode-casefold both query and searchable text, and require every token to occur as a substring somewhere in the product's SKU, name or tags. Return all products for an empty/whitespace-only query, preserve input order, accept any product iterable and do not mutate inputs. Reject nonstring queries with TypeError. Keep the function signature and validate simple and multi-token cases.

Fix paginate in inventory/search.py to use one-based page numbers: page 1 starts at item 0 and later pages are contiguous without gaps. Keep the signature and defaults, return a list with original item identities, support list/tuple input, and return [] beyond the end. Reject bool/noninteger page or page_size with TypeError and nonpositive values with ValueError. Keep other behavior intact and validate boundary pages.

Fix build_headers in inventory/client.py: omit X-API-TOKEN for None, empty, or whitespace-only tokens; otherwise strip surrounding whitespace while preserving internal characters. Keep Accept, optional X-REQUEST-ID values, fresh-dict behavior, the signature and TypeError for nonstring tokens unchanged. Validate all empty-token and request-id cases without changing other client helpers.

Fix retry_delay in inventory/client.py to return capped exponential delays base_delay * 2**attempt, with attempt 0 using base_delay. Safely cap very large attempts without overflow or an unbounded loop; zero delays remain supported. Keep defaults, numeric delay conversion, and finite/nonnegative validation. Reject bool/noninteger attempts with TypeError and negative attempts with ValueError. Preserve the API and validate custom caps and boundary inputs.

Fix decode_response in inventory/client.py: every integer status 200 through 299 is successful and returns the exact original payload object, including None for 204. Every other integer status raises the existing RemoteError with its status_code and message preserved. Reject bool/noninteger statuses with TypeError. Keep the public signature and exception facade; validate success and failure boundaries.

Fix validate_event in inventory/events.py to trim an incoming string event id before checking blankness and duplicate membership. Return the normalized id in a shallow copy, preserving extra fields and the original payload. Whitespace-only or duplicate normalized ids must raise ValueError. Keep allowed kinds, nonstring-id rejection, seen_ids handling and the signature compatible. Validate service integration without changing the other modules.

Make encode_event in inventory/events.py produce deterministic compact JSON: sort object keys recursively, use no separator whitespace, and emit Unicode characters rather than ASCII escapes. Preserve the signature, JSON round-trip values, unsupported-value TypeError, and the input object. Keep event validation behavior intact and validate reordered/nested payloads.

Fix summarize in inventory/service.py so inventory_value_cents sums price_cents * stock for every product, including zero stock and an empty iterable. Keep the signature, product_count, total_stock, sorted low_stock_skus rule (stock < 2), generator support, integer results and input immutability unchanged. Validate multiple prices and stocks without changing other modules.
